# Real Data Plots

## Vaccine Comparison

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
# Figure 2
source('scripts/bounds_compare.R')
source('scripts/real_data_plots.R')

load('data_vaccine.rda')
vacccine_efficiency_comparison(data_vaccine, delta = 0.1, gamma = 3, xi = 2, alpha = 0.95, conf.type = 'normal')
```

## Heatmap and Contour plot


```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=12}
# Figure 3
source('scripts/heatmap.R')
source('scripts/real_data_plots.R')

load('data_confounders.rda')
heatmap_confounders(data_confounders, grid = 10, alpha = 0.95, conf.type = 'normal')
```


# Numerical Simulations

## Confidence Interval Comparison

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
# Figure A1
source('./scripts/CI_compare.R')
set.seed(123)
o = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4)
CI_comparison(o, delta=0.1, gamma=5, xi=2, alpha=0.95, n.population=1000, n.sim=20)
```


## Heatmap for same Odds Ratio

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
# Figure A2(a)
source('./scripts/heatmap_same_odds_ratio.R')
heatmap_same_odds_ratio(0.5, delta = 0.1, gamma = 5, xi=Inf, grid=50, log.transform=TRUE)
```


```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
# Figure A2(b)
source('./scripts/heatmap_same_odds_ratio.R')
heatmap_same_odds_ratio(0.5, delta = 0.1, gamma = 5, xi=2, grid=10, log.transform=TRUE)
```


## Continuous Confounder


```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=12}
# Figure A3
source('scripts/continuous.R')
set.seed(123456)
plot_continuous_confounder_simultaion(delta = 0.1, gamma = 5, xi = 2, n.test = 5, n.population = 50000, n.sim = 10, alpha = 0.95, conf.type = 'normal')
```
